newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chronology of major Latam air crashes since 1993.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of major Latam air crashes since 1993.

text.p: In the third major air disaster in South America this month, a commercial jet crashed in a residential area of Sao Paulo on Thursday, killing all 95 people on board and eight on the ground.
Here is a list of major aviation accidents in Latin America since 1993.

-- Oct. 22, 1996 - A Boeing 707 cargo plane, belonging to U.S. airline Million Air, burst into flames and crashed into a densely populated poor district of the port of Manta in southeast Ecuador, killing 25 and injuring 60.
-- Oct. 2, 1996 - A Boeing 757 jet, belonging to local airline Aeroperu, plunged into the Pacific off Peru, killing all 70 on board.
-- Feb. 7, 1996 - A Dominican Alas Nacionales Boeing 757 carrying 189 people plunged into waters off the Dominican Republic, killing all on board.

-- Feb. 29, 1996 - A Peruvian Faucett airline Boeing 737 crashed in the Andes, killing all 117 passengers and six crew members. The plane, on a flight from Lima, slammed into a mountain as it prepared to land at the city of Arequipa in the south of the country.

-- Dec. 20, 1995 - An American Airlines passenger jet en route from Miami crashed into a mountain in southwest Colombia and burst into flames, killing 163 people on board. Four people survived the crash.
-- Nov. 8, 1995 - An air force Fokker 27 plane crashed in central Argentina's mountains, killing all 53 on board.

-- Aug. 9, 1995 - A Boeing 737 jet, belonging to Guatemalan's Aviateca airline, en route from Miami, slammed into the Chichontepec volcano in El Salvador and burst into flames, killing all 65 people on board.

-- Feb. 4, 1995 - A DC-8 cargo plane, belonging to Colombia's Lineas Aereas del Caribe, crashed into homes near Paraguay's capital Asuncion, killing 22 people, most of them children from a volleyball team.
-- July 20, 1994 - All 21 passengers died when a Brazilian-built Embraer BP-110 jet, belonging to Panama's Alas Airlines, exploded in flight and crashed into the jungle in eastern Panama.
-- May 19, 1993 - All 132 passengers and crew were killed when a Boeing 727, belonging to local airline SAM, crashed into a jungle mountain near Medellin in northwest Colombia.
